Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows sharply demarcated, thin-walled cystic cavities with air-fluid levels in the left lower lobe (retrocardiac region), which is a classic radiographic presentation of an infected intralobar pulmonary sequestration. Other options are inconsistent with the specific morphology (thin-walled vs. thick-walled abscess/TB) or location (left lower lobe vs. right upper lobe/emphysema).
